reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows shows GAAP quarterly earnings subtotals improving while company-reported point-in-time nonperforming and past-due credit measures also rose. The income statement movement is an accounting identity chain (net interest income after provision, noninterest income and expense, pretax income, tax expense, net income), not a causal explanation; the extract contains no drivers such as balance-sheet mix, margin decomposition, charge-off or reserve detail, or segment commentary. The credit deterioration is small in displayed magnitude and rests on rounded point-in-time balances without loan-growth context, so it cannot be scaled against the earnings improvement. Because the selected evidence supports both a favorable earnings read and an adverse asset-quality read without a source-backed bridge between them, the research state is held for review rather than upgraded or invalidated; conviction and status are unchanged and the thesis remains blocked pending complete filing evidence.
